'''Ali-Le''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss commandos|Voss commando]] [[Adjudicators|Adjudicator]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she was stationed at the commando outpost on [[Koss Overlook]] in the [[Gormak Lands]], overlooking [[Gorma-Koss]]. She informed a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] about Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]], who went into the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] territory to negotiate with the Gormak.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ali-Le appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Captive Audience" on Voss.<ref name="SWTOR" />
